property_summary: After an owner calls transferOwnership(newOwner) with a non-zero newOwner different from the caller, ownership must pass to exactly newOwner; the mutant instead always assigns ownership to the caller, so c.owner() != newOwner for any fuzzed newOwner distinct from the caller.
change_summary: Replace _transferOwnership(newOwner) with _transferOwnership(_msgSender()) so ownership is always transferred to the caller instead of newOwner.
